newsitem.title: USA: CUNO says 2nd half of yr to improve.
newsitem.headline: CUNO says 2nd half of yr to improve.

text.p: CUNO Inc said Thursday it believes the second half of the of 1997 will reflect continued improvements over the first half.
The company said its second half of the year is traditionally stronger than its first half and it expects that to continue in 1997.
It also said its new products have been well received, and it is anticipating the products will gain momentum during the next six months.
The company said its efforts to increase market share in Europe and Japan are expected to positively impact performance.
The company reported earnings per share for the second quarter of $0.24 compared with $0.24 for the same period a year ago.
CUNO makes and sells filtration products for the separation, clarification and purification of liquids and gases.
